summary: Kaptur voted Yea on H.R. 6090, incorporating the IHRA definition into federal education-discrimination enforcement, and for H.R. 8034, which provided over $17 billion in security assistance to Israel. Her 2024 press releases described the conflict as 'the war in Gaza,' and she issued statements on the 2025 ceasefire and hostage-release agreement. Vote for Peace rated her Opposed in the general election.
